diagnosis.mechanism: At narrow width, estimated heights of unrendered articles are far off, so after the jump the target oscillated by about ±2,500px as neighbours rendered; the bounded settle (6 × ~60ms) could end misaligned, or a later web-font swap moved an aligned target by 30px; the R1 trailing pass then truthfully selected the article at the line (191/192). Fonts are one cause, not the only one (fonts blocked still failed 1/3).

repair.summary: An explicit navigation holds its target at the reading line until reader intent or the next explicit navigation. While held: browser scroll anchoring is off on the column; a ResizeObserver on #flow, #active-bar and #load-status, font loadingdone and each settle end realign synchronously against the reachable position (drift); intent is only the column leaving the position this code last set (bottom-edge clamp excepted), checked on scroll, before every realign and settle retry; passive tracking does not reassign the selection. Bounds: 40 chains + 400 immediate corrections (reset when aligned); after a spent budget one more chain per 700ms quiet spell, at most 30 per hold; exhaustion is marked (reader:hold-exhausted, reader:hold-recovery-exhausted) and never ends the hold. Volver realigns a held target; a stale fill only realigns the target still held. There is no release timer: the hold has no time limit.
